answer: Commit a salted hash of the result at t0, reveal it at t0+30 min, publish the salt. Peers replay the reveal and compare. A farm cannot reuse one result across 1,000 accounts because each commit must carry a distinct salt and a distinct input hash; reusing either is caught at reveal. Numbers: 2 rounds, 1 salt, 30 minutes, 0 exceptions. No identity may audit its own recruit. The vault opens once, so a fabricated sonnet has to be carved in marble before the input is known.
